messages:
Nora: Quick thread  decision on final speaker slate + rehearsal cadence for Sept webinar. Topic: "Scaling inference with minimal ops". Goal: 40m, 2 live demos + customer vignette, strong CTA to self-serve trial.
Ben: I'd keep 3 speakers but only 2 live demos. One demo should be super reproducible in a browser.
Claudia: Agreed. Suggest demo A = latency tuning (live, browser-friendly), demo B = migration path (recorded + live commentary). Customer vignette = short slides + metrics.
Ravi: Speaker candidates: Mei (infra eng), Lukas (solutions), Tasha (customer eng at Marketly). Mei can do live but needs a staging key and a small dataset. Lukas prefers recorded demos. Tasha can present slides + 90s clip.
Nora: Can we score people quickly? simple rubric: demo_repro(1-5), time_zone_fit(1-5), audience_draw(1-5).
Ben: Quick scores: Mei 5/4/3=12, Lukas 3/5/4=12, Tasha 4/5/4=13. Lean Tasha + Mei as primary, Lukas as backup.
Claudia: Rehearsal windows: Sept 6 10am PT (NA), Sept 8 3pm BST (EU). Ask: can primary speakers do both?
Mei: I can do Sept 6 only. Tasha: I can do both. Lukas: Sept 8 only.
Nora: OK schedule: run dry-run 1 on Sept 6 (full team except Lukas). Dry-run 2 Sept 8 (include Lukas). Keep each dry-run <= 60m.
Ben: Run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-00:03 host intro (Nora)
00:03-00:15 Mei live demo (latency tuning, browser)
00:15-00:22 Tasha customer vignette + clip
00:22-00:30 Lukas recorded migration demo + live Q
00:30-00:38 panel Q (moderated)
00:38-00:40 CTA + 48h promo code reveal
```
Claudia: Lead routing: landing page tags utm_campaign=sept_scale_webinar and utm_demo=latency|migration. Attendee scoring: attended=true, asked_q binary, watch_pct numeric. Routing rules: attended+asked_q -> sales-fasttrack; attended only -> marketing-nurture.
Ravi: Also recommend a small post-event experiment: send two follow-ups (A: immediate trial code with 1-click activation; B: short personalized note from solutions rep + trial code). Measure trial activation and product engagement 72h.
Nora: Failure modes & fallback: if live demo fails in first 60s -> switch to recorded clip and presenter does live walkthrough. If audio fails -> continue with chat Q + follow-up clip. Ops: upload recorded clips to rehearsal doc.
Ben: Tech checklist for rehearsals: public staging key (read-only), browser spec (Chrome latest), test corpus, recorded fallback clips, slide deck single file. Also capture presenters' constraints in doc (no VPN, camera off ok).
Claudia: ops-bot: please schedule invites + reminders, post RSVP counts to #marketing daily at 9am PT starting 7 days out. ops-bot: will schedule 72h/24h/1h reminders and post counts. :robot_face:
ops-bot: Reminder templates and rehearsal doc link uploaded to /marketing/webinars/sept-scale.
Nora: Action items: 1) Ben confirm Mei staging key request today. 2) Claudia build landing + UTM variants. 3) Ravi draft follow-up A/B flows. 4) ops-bot schedule rehearsals once speakers confirmed.
Ben: I'll ping infra for a read-only key and confirm by EOD.
Nora: Great. Lock speakers by EOD tomorrow so we can prep slides and record fallback clips. Thanks team. :sparkles:
